description: Hack-Tic-Thon ~ Come With Ideas, Leave With Bugs: is a Gen-Z, unconventional hackathon organized under Tech-Melange '26, The Annual Tech Fest of ENIAC Society, Department of Computer Science, Shaheed Rajguru College of Applied Sciences for Women, University of Delhi. Eligibility & Team Formation: The hackathon is open to participants from any college, university, specialization or educational background. Inter-college and inter-specialization teams are allowed. Each team must consist of 2–3 members. Participants shall participate under the Open Innovation track. Participation is free. Format: The hackathon will consist of 2 rounds: ROUND 1 — ONLINE PPT + PROJECT SUBMISSION: THE BRAINROT BEGINS Submission Period: 26 September – 9 October 2026 Teams must submit a PPT along with their properly coded project/MVP, MVP screenshots, GitHub repository link and project demo. PPT Guidelines: Teams may design their presentation freely. No fixed PPT template will be provided. The presentation must contain a maximum of 10 slides, including the Introduction/Title Slide and Ending/Thank You Slide. The presentation may be arranged in any format but should cover: Problem / OpportunitY Proposed Solution Workflow Features Technologies Used Innovation / Feasibility Impact / Future Vision MVP Snapshots GitHub Repository Link Project Demo Teams selected through the Round 1 evaluation will proceed to the offline finale. ROUND 2 — OFFLINE FINALE: THE FINAL CRASHOUT Finale Date: 15 October 2026 Venue: Shaheed Rajguru College of Applied Sciences for Women, University of Delhi Finalist teams will present their complete project before the judges, covering: Idea and problem statement Proposed solution Development approach Technical implementation Final prototype/MVP Live project demonstration Teams may use their PPT, live demo, prototype or any other material necessary to showcase their project. Each team will be given a total of 10 minutes for their final presentation and demonstration. Genera

raw.details:
Hack-Tic-Thon ~ Come With Ideas, Leave With Bugs:

  • is a Gen-Z, unconventional hackathon organized under Tech-Melange '26, The Annual Tech Fest of ENIAC Society, Department of Computer Science, Shaheed Rajguru College of Applied Sciences for Women, University of Delhi.

Eligibility & Team Formation:

  • The hackathon is open to participants from any college, university, specialization or educational background.
  • Inter-college and inter-specialization teams are allowed.
  • Each team must consist of 2–3 members.
  • Participants shall participate under the Open Innovation track.
  • Participation is free.

Format:

  • The hackathon will consist of 2 rounds:

ROUND 1 — ONLINE PPT + PROJECT SUBMISSION:

  • THE BRAINROT BEGINS
  • Submission Period: 26 September – 9 October 2026
  • Teams must submit a PPT along with their properly coded project/MVP, MVP screenshots, GitHub repository link and project demo.

PPT Guidelines:

  • Teams may design their presentation freely. No fixed PPT template will be provided.
  • The presentation must contain a maximum of 10 slides, including the Introduction/Title Slide and Ending/Thank You Slide.
  • The presentation may be arranged in any format but should cover:
  • Problem / OpportunitY
  • Proposed Solution
  • Workflow
  • Features
  • Technologies Used
  • Innovation / Feasibility
  • Impact / Future Vision
  • MVP Snapshots
  • GitHub Repository Link
  • Project Demo
  • Teams selected through the Round 1 evaluation will proceed to the offline finale.

ROUND 2 — OFFLINE FINALE:

  • THE FINAL CRASHOUT
  • Finale Date: 15 October 2026
  • Venue: Shaheed Rajguru College of Applied Sciences for Women, University of Delhi
  • Finalist teams will present their complete project before the judges, covering:
  • Idea and problem statement
  • Proposed solution
  • Development approach
  • Technical implementation
  • Final prototype/MVP
  • Live project demonstration
  • Teams may use their PPT, live demo, prototype or any other material necessary to showcase their project.
  • Each team will be given a total of 10 minutes for their final presentation and demonstration.

General Rules:

  • Each team must submit original work.
  • Teams must ensure that all submitted links and materials are accessible to the organizers and judges.
  • Teams are responsible for ensuring that their submitted project, GitHub repository and demo are functional and available for evaluation.
  • Submissions received after the specified deadline may not be considered.
  • Participants must follow the instructions and deadlines communicated by the organizing team.
  • The decisions of the judges regarding evaluation and selection will be final.
  • The organizers reserve the right to disqualify teams for plagiarism, misrepresentation, violation of rules or submission of work that does not belong to the participating team.
